observations: Black UPS unit with a purple vertical strip on the front panel.
Brand 'BLUE GATE' is embossed on the top of the unit in both photos.
The unit has a power button and three indicator lights (green, yellow, red) on the front panel.
The rear of the unit is visible in photo 1, showing a 3-pin plug and a power cable.
The unit shows signs of surface wear and dirt on the casing.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a standard desktop UPS unit.
The unit's internal battery and inverter health cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or the battery may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powering on and the green battery light staying on.

risks.risk: The inverter may be faulty or the output voltage unstable.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running a load (like a computer) while the power is switched off.

risks.risk: The unit may be a counterfeit or a generic clone.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification label on the back of the unit.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the unit showing the model number and capacity.
Video of the unit powered on and the battery light illuminated.
Video of the unit running a load to test the inverter.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
